text:
pip: Quick idea thread  we need a launch-ready benchmark narrative thats simple enough for a blog hero but nerdy enough for an ops deep-dive. Deliverables: hero chart, 2 supporting visuals, gated estimator (notebook or sheet), and 2 social hooks.
omar: For the hero: condensed contour (latency target on x, throughput on y) with iso-cost lines. make the callout say 'pick an SLO, read the cost'. Keep copy short.
sasha: Supporting visuals: 1) savings waterfall (quant->batch->cache) 2) small table mapping common workloads to recommended knobs (burst / steady / convo). We should include realistic ranges, e.g., 15-35% for batching on steady workloads.
lucy: Routing and funnel: signup form collects monthly_tokens and primary_goal (dev, infra, partner). Buckets: <75k self-serve, 75k-400k nurture, >400k SDR. Tag 'bench_interest' and 'bench_tier'. Track which CTA they clicked.
pip: I want one CTA variant for devs ("Run the notebook") and one for buyers ("Request ROI review"). A/B test both on the landing.
benchbot: bench export: https://internal.benchmarks.redwood/1809999999 file: bench-contour-release.csv (batch sizes 1/8/16/32, cache on/off, q4/q8 variants).
omar: Copy hooks: hero headline "From latency targets to dollars" subhead "See how configuration choices change your monthly bill." Social blurb short: "Pick your SLO. See the bill."
sasha: Visual microcopy: annotate the knee where batch+cache combine; add a tiny note: "estimates assume steady throughput & typical tokenization". Export PNG 1200x630 and SVG for blog.
lucy: Gated estimator: preference = Jupyter notebook (runnable) + downloadable sheet. Notebook should have a sample dataset, sliders for tokens/min, batch, quant, cache toggle, and an export CSV button.
pip: Include a one-line curl for quick API estimates too. Example: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/estimate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-13b-q4","tokens_per_min":2000,"batch":8,"cache":true}'
```
omar: Analytics: capture notebook run (yes/no), sheet download, and API sample copy. Route >400k monthly_tokens or if notebook run indicates >$500/mo savings -> SDR.
sasha: Design ask: add an alt-text for each visual and a tiny thumbnail variant for social. Keep color contrast high.
lucy: Timeline proposal: data + kneepoint numbers by Mon, visuals mock Wed, gated notebook + page Fri, social + blog next Tue, webinar 7-10 days after. Owners: omar numbers & copy, sasha visuals, pip notebook, lucy routing.
pip: I'll prototype the notebook as a minimal binder that runs headless with the provided CSV by Mon EOD.
omar: I'll push the kneepoint and a small CSV slice to the internal link above.
sasha: I'll post Figma mocks Wed morning; will include PNG 1200x630.
lucy: I'll wire the form + zap and test on staging Thu.
pip: small follow-ups: omar, include explicit batch sizes and quant deltas in CSV; sasha, export a slide-safe PNG and a thumbnail PNG; lucy, confirm CRM tag names before Friday. :rocket:
